_help: Hand inputs for sim.py, keyed season-round. Once qualifying is done the sim uses OpenF1's official starting grid (sim_data.py); these are for before that, or to correct it. The confirmed penalties penalty_watch.py finds (penalties table) are added automatically; this file wins where both set one. grid_penalty: places dropped from the qualifying position; back: starts from the back; pitlane: starts from the pit lane; grid: the full grid as a list of codes (wins over OpenF1's); pace: % of lap time added (+ slower, - faster), e.g. for damage or upgrades.
